description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single ranged jump attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Wind with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Dragoon Mode I (Fang v2)] and [Dragoon Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Attach Wind with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Wind Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Wind 3

description.name: Dual Awoken Dragoon Mode I (Fang v2)
description.text: Dragoon abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Dragoon abilities trigger 2 additional times, chases 1/2/3+ Dragoon abilities with cast speed x2.00/2.50/3.00 to Dragoon abilities, chases every 3rd Dragoon ability with Dual Bahamut Dive
